title: Just Enough Pickups (JEP)
description: Disables Auto Pickup unless item is allowed by the filter system. Or just right click to pick 'em up! Advanced filtering options included.
body:
![# Just Enough Pickups](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5dc40df5ceb6057d4f0d1f847b3b31bde6f8bc16.png)
\
\
\
**Just Enough Pickups** is a QoL mod made primarily to solve the problem of filling up inventory with rubbish without the need of another container by using a pickup filtering system.

![Item Tooltip with item filter disabled on this item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/BG8JCZxm/images/3379dca2dc5b4057049594180b6d3ab80b9fc1ec_350.webp)

## **Features**:
- **Vanila-style Tooltip**: Renders on dropped items. Toggle by [H] by default.
  
- **Easy-to-use filter**: Easily add item to filter list to be auto picked up by a key, [I] by default.
  
- **Advanced Configuration Screen**: Allow items to be auto picked up alongside with an in-game user-friendly guide. Toggle by [G] by default.
  
- **Advanced Item Filter**: The filter whitelist supports filtering by item id, item group tags, NBT tags and more(see in-game)! Also supports Datapacks items unlike other mods(check /data get entity @s SelectedItem for tags!).
  
- **Right Click Pickup**: Immersively pick up items on ground by just right click. All pickups not allowed by filter list are disabled.
  
- **Simple item physics**: Just simple visual physics on dropped items. Credits to [Better Dropped Items](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/better-dropped-items)

Requires Fabric API

Check the gallery for in-game images.
